description: Report the state of the link between this server and the user's Parfumo account: whether an account is linked and in which mode, whether the Parfumo session is valid right now, the nickname, and today's remaining quota of each tool with publicly visible writes (daily cap per user). Use it when an account tool fails, or before a series of public writes. Never returns credentials or cookies.
name: parfumo_session_status

Quota.description: Daily budget of one tool for the calling user.

daily_cap.description: Publicly visible writes allowed per day for this user (0: forbidden).

last_login_at.description: Last login of the server on Parfumo (UTC).

link_url.description:
Page where the user links or relinks the account: the `/link` page of an HTTP server,
or the login page a local stdio server opens on the user's own computer when the
account has to be linked. Absent when there is nothing to link, or when the account
of a local server comes from the environment of the process.

linked.description: Whether a Parfumo account is linked for this user.

min_request_interval_ms.description: Minimum interval between two requests of this user to Parfumo, in milliseconds.

mode.description: `credentials` (the server logs in again by itself) or `cookie` (the user pastes a new cookie when it expires).

nick.description: Nickname of the linked Parfumo account, when the session is valid.

public_writes_enabled.description: Whether this server sends publicly visible writes at all; when false they are dry runs.

quotas.description: Today's budget of each tool with publicly visible writes, for this user.

quotas_reset_in_secs.description: Seconds until the daily counts reset (00:00 UTC).

session.description: State of the Parfumo session right now: `valid`, `not_linked`, `reauth_required`, `captcha_required` or `error`.

write_recipients.description: Members this server may write to (message, wall, follow); empty when unrestricted.
